accepted.title: Groups admitting polynomial geodesic growth
accepted.text: Characterize finitely generated groups G for which some finite monoid-generating set S has polynomial geodesic growth: there are constants C,d such that the number of words w over S with |w|≤n and |w| equal to the S-word length of their product is at most C(1+n)^d for every n≥0. S need not be symmetric.
accepted.subject: Group Theory & Geometric Group Theory

locator.verified_from: Held PDF pdftotext -layout with printed footer; actual physical pages, not inflated extractor page indices.

accepted.scope_review: The thesis defines generating sets as monoid-generating in Definition2.1.1, printed21. Geodesic growth here is cumulative; multiplicities of symbols are not needed for this existential property. Theorem4.A and Corollary4.B characterize virtually class≤2 groups through the finite-action polytope condition, leaving the global characterization unproved. This target differs from the symmetric higher-step exclusion and the algorithmic finite-action classification.

accepted.title: Polynomial geodesic growth of the asymmetric virtually Engel example
accepted.text: Let vE be the group generated by a,t with t²=1; writing b=t⁻¹at and c=[a,[a,b]], impose [b,[a,b]]=c and require c to commute with a and b. Is its geodesic growth with respect to the finite monoid-generating set S={a,b,(ab)⁻¹,t} bounded above by a polynomial? Here geodesic growth counts words over S of length at most n that minimize S-word length for their product.
accepted.subject: Group Theory & Geometric Group Theory

accepted.title: Cube-root word-versus-Stoll error in metabelian nilpotent groups
accepted.text: Let H be a finitely generated torsion-free metabelian nilpotent group and X a finite monoid-generating set. In its Mal’cev completion define ||h||_Stoll,X as the infimum of ∑μ_i over all products h=x_1^{μ_1}⋯x_k^{μ_k}, with x_i∈X and real μ_i>0. Is there a constant C depending only on H,X such that 0≤||h||_X−||h||_Stoll,X≤C(1+||h||_X)^{1/3} for every h∈H?
accepted.subject: Group Theory & Geometric Group Theory

accepted.title: Finitely many Busemann orbits for class-two nilpotent groups
accepted.text: For a finite symmetric generating set S, ∂(G,d_S) consists of pointwise limits, along sequences escaping finite sets, of h↦d_S(x,h)−d_S(x,e). If G is finitely generated nilpotent of class at most2, must the left-translation action on its Busemann points have finitely many orbits? A Busemann point here is a horofunction obtained as the limit along a geodesic ray; the action is (g·φ)(h)=φ(g⁻¹h)−φ(g⁻¹).

accepted.title: Groups whose rational subsets have bounded regular representatives
accepted.text: Characterize finitely generated groups G such that, for every rational subset R⊂G, there exists a bounded regular language L′ over a finite alphabet of elements of G with ev(L′)=R. Here rational means R=ev(L) for some regular L, and bounded means L′⊂w_1*⋯w_k* for finitely many fixed words w_i. In particular, determine this property for all class-two nilpotent groups with cyclic derived subgroup.
accepted.subject: Group Theory & Geometric Group Theory
